name: Market Microstructure
description: See how an order book works, what trading really costs, and how market makers quote.

lessonNames.l5-crossing-the-spread: The cost of crossing the spread
lessonNames.l11-adverse-selection: Trading against someone who knows more

lessonObjectives.l1-bids-and-asks: Read the bids, the asks and the spread in a limit order book.
lessonObjectives.l2-walking-the-book: Compute the average fill price of a market order that eats several levels.
lessonObjectives.l3-the-queue: Explain price-time priority for limit orders.
lessonObjectives.l4-market-or-limit: Choose an order type by trading price against certainty of execution.
lessonObjectives.l5-crossing-the-spread: Compute the round-trip cost of crossing the spread.
lessonObjectives.l6-impact: Estimate slippage from order size and book depth.
lessonObjectives.l7-where-is-the-price: Compare the mid price with a size-weighted microprice.
lessonObjectives.l8-liquidity: Compare liquidity by spread, depth and volume.
lessonObjectives.l9-both-sides: Set a two-sided quote around a fair value.
lessonObjectives.l10-inventory: Shift quotes to reduce unwanted inventory.
lessonObjectives.l11-adverse-selection: Explain adverse selection and why it widens spreads.
lessonObjectives.l12-venues: Describe lit exchanges, dark pools and opening and closing auctions.
